svg.title: Compass (act-expert) — string diagram: what Compass DOES (dark)
svg.desc: A string diagram read left to right, dark theme. Boxes are morphisms, tinted blue; lines are wires carrying objects and none of them has an arrowhead. Two wires enter on the left, "a proposed composition" and "a vantage (seed by ranking)", into the box "query alice", which emits the wire "a workspace state" into the box "walk the graph", which emits the wire "a graph walk". That wire meets a red Frobenius node where it splits into two: the upper branch enters the box "judge" and leaves as "a verdict"; the lower branch enters the box "observe back" and leaves as "an epoch". A short stub wire drops downward off "walk the graph" into a small box "check presence", which emits a stub wire "a cid"; it is captioned "the register — position only" and marked as a side consultation rather than a step in the composition. A second wire leaves "judge" in purple, runs right, loops back over the top of the whole diagram and enters "query alice" from the left as "a proposal": this is a TRACE, a loop closing on a shared object, and it is labelled as such. A retraction panel records that this loop was previously and wrongly labelled a cap, and that the snake law has been withdrawn because there is no cap here. A law panel lists the cumulative obligations in order — monoidal, symmetric, traced with Selinger's four trace axioms, symmetric traced yanking, compact closed (self-dual), and hypergraph. The compact closed row records that cup and cap are derived from the Frobenius maps by Fong and Spivak Proposition 3.1, that neither is drawn here, and the two separate reasons the snake claim was dropped: it is false where it was pointed, and it is not independently owed. The hypergraph row is marked as the root from which every row above it derives. A separate inset law panel draws the Frobenius specialness law as an equation with both sides: on the left a wire splits at a node and merges again at a second node, on the right a plain identity wire, with an equals sign between them; it is marked DEFINITIONAL, because specialness is an axiom of the structure rather than a theorem about it. A caveat panel states the root: exactly one claim in this diagram is genuinely unproven, namely that Compass's workflow category is a hypergraph category, and that claim lives outside this picture. It also states that the diagram does not show whether any run discharged the laws.

node.label: a graph walk ⊗ a graph walk

arrow.label: a proposal (a TRACE — the loop closes on a shared object; NOT a cap)

commutes.reason: Specialness is an AXIOM of a *special* commutative Frobenius monoid (Fong-Spivak arXiv:1806.08304 Def 2.5, the (special) axiom), and a hypergraph category is DEFINED as one where every object carries that structure (ibid. §2.2). A #def would re-prove the definition. CAVEAT: DEFINITIONAL discharges the law GIVEN the structure — "this category IS hypergraph" is a separate unproven claim living OUTSIDE this picture. Ruled by Compass 2026-08-23.

svg.text: Compass (act-expert) — STRING DIAGRAM: what Compass DOES
string diagram — boxes are MORPHISMS · lines are WIRES carrying objects, never arrows and never arrowheads · Fong §1.2.2 · Fong–Spivak arXiv:1806.08304
In the Universe of Bytes.
a proposal — the traced object X
a TRACE, Tr^X — the output loops back as a proposal (antimatter)
NOT a cap: a cap is a counit A ⊗ A* → I and ends in the monoidal unit
⛔ RETRACTED 2026-08-23 — see the retraction panel below
a proposed composition
a vantage (seed × ranking)
query alice
a workspace state
walk the graph
a graph walk
check presence
a cid
the register — position only
a SIDE consultation, not a step in the composition
Frobenius: one walk, two uses
judge
a verdict
observe back
an epoch
⛔ RETRACTED 2026-08-23 — this diagram claimed “SNAKE / YANKING at the cap”. THERE IS NO CAP HERE.
The loop from “judge” back into “query alice” was labelled a CAP. A cap is a counit ε : A ⊗ A* → I — it TERMINATES IN THE MONOIDAL UNIT.
This wire feeds an output back to an earlier input: it closes a loop on a SHARED OBJECT and yields A → B. That is a TRACE — Selinger §5.1,
Tr^X : hom(A ⊗ X, B ⊗ X) → hom(A, B). No cap ⇒ no snake. The SNAKE row is WITHDRAWN — but the COMPACT CLOSED row is NOT; see the law panel.

The GEOMETRY was never wrong — §5.1: a right trace “is graphically represented by drawing a loop from the output X to the input X”. The NAME was. Compact closed ⇒ symmetric traced (§5.7), so the structure stands.
THE LAWS THIS DIAGRAM OBLIGES — cumulative
monoidal
pentagon · triangle
symmetric
interchange · σ ∘ σ = 1
traced
Selinger §5.1 — the four axioms, verbatim:
(a) Tightening — naturality in A, B
(b) Sliding — dinaturality in X
(c) Vanishing — Tr^I f = f · Tr^(X⊗Y) f = Tr^X(Tr^Y f)
(d) Strength — Tr^X(g ⊗ f) = g ⊗ Tr^X f
symmetric traced
Yanking — Tr^X(c_X,X) = id_X (Selinger §5.7)
§5.1: Strength is Selinger’s PLANAR replacement for Joyal–Street–
Verity’s non-planar Superposing. Ours is symmetric, so Yanking holds.
compact closed
(self-dual) — cup = η;δ · cap = μ;ε
DERIVED from the Frobenius structure [FS Prop 3.1]. Neither is drawn
here; the snake follows from Frobenius + unitality and is NOT an
independent obligation. TWO reasons the SNAKE row was dropped:
· FALSE WHERE IT WAS POINTED — instantiated at w11 the snake would
assert Tr^proposal(g) = id: that Compass’s whole feedback loop is the
IDENTITY. The diagram’s own content contradicts that.
· NOT INDEPENDENTLY OWED — FS Prop 3.1’s proof: the zigzag identities
are “an IMMEDIATE CONSEQUENCE of the Frobenius and co/unitality axioms”.
hypergraph
SPECIAL COMMUTATIVE FROBENIUS at ●
drawn as an equation, both sides, in the panel at right →
⛔ THIS ROW IS THE ROOT — every row above it DERIVES from it. See the caveat panel.
Checking interchange alone validates this in a category we are not in.
LAW PANEL — SPECIALNESS, both sides
δ ; μ = id on a graph walk
δ
μ
a graph walk ⊗ a graph walk

a graph walk
status = DEFINITIONAL — declared as `frobenius-special` here.
The MAIN FLOW draws the COMULTIPLY only: its two branches end at
distinct boundary ports and never rejoin. The MERGE exists only here,
as the left-hand side of an equation — never as a wire in the workflow.
Fong–Spivak arXiv:1806.08304 §2.2 — special commutative Frobenius.
WHY DEFINITIONAL AND NOT UNPROVEN — Compass, 2026-08-23
Specialness is an AXIOM of a *special* commutative Frobenius monoid:
FS Def 2.5 lists (special) alongside (Frobenius) as an axiom of the
structure, and a hypergraph category is DEFINED (ibid. §2.2) as one
where every object carries it. δ;μ = id is part of BEING the structure.
A #def would re-prove the definition; UNPROVEN scheduled that work.
CAVEAT: DEFINITIONAL discharges the law GIVEN the structure. “This
category IS hypergraph” is a separate UNPROVEN claim, and it lives
OUTSIDE this picture — see the caveat panel below.
WHAT THIS DIAGRAM CANNOT SHOW
⛔ THE ROOT — EXACTLY ONE CLAIM IN THIS DIAGRAM IS GENUINELY UNPROVEN: that Compass’s workflow category IS A HYPERGRAPH CATEGORY.

The δ drawn at ● asserts it — AND IT IS NOW MEASURED: 99 of 99 hyperedges in the substrate's graph connect MORE THAN TWO nodes (arity 4-10), which is exactly Fong-Spivak's characterization of a morphism indexed by a finite SET rather than a domain/codomain pair. The hypergraph STRUCTURE is a re-measurable fact; Def 2.12's Frobenius structure closes the categorical statement by instantiation. Everything else in the law panel either PRESUPPOSES it (monoidal, symmetric — FS Def 2.12: a hypergraph category IS a symmetric monoidal category with extra structure) or is DERIVED from it (compact closed, symmetric traced) — compact closed by Fong–Spivak Prop 3.1
(“every hypergraph category is self-dual compact closed”), and symmetric traced by Selinger §5.7 (“obviously every compact closed category is
symmetric traced”). That claim lives OUTSIDE this picture: it is NOT a <commutes> block, because it is not an equation between two paths drawn here.
This shows the actions and the laws they oblige. It does not show whether any particular run discharged them.
The five trace axioms are LISTED, not DRAWN. Each is an equation between two diagrams, and only one side of each is present here.
There is NO wire crossing anywhere in this picture, so it asserts no symmetry σ; σ ∘ σ = 1 is an obligation of the tier, listed and not drawn.
Nor does it rule on the laws — a renderer that judges its own output is a verifier that cannot fail. Compass rules; this file only declares.
a WIRE — carries an object. NO ARROWHEAD, ever: in a hypergraph category a morphism is indexed by a finite SET, not a domain/codomain pair.
a FROBENIUS node — where one wire SPLITS into two, or two MERGE into one. The main flow draws a SPLIT only; the MERGE is in the law panel.
a TRACE — a wire that LOOPS BACK, closing on a SHARED object: Tr^X : hom(A ⊗ X, B ⊗ X) → hom(A, B). NOT a cap; a cap ends in the unit I.
